extracted.name: Grandma's Salad Dressing
extracted.description: This sweet and tangy salad dressing with ketchup, oil, and vinegar is a family heirloom that has dressed many salads through the generations.
instruction_lines: Add oil, vinegar, sugar, ketchup, salt, Worcestershire sauce, and onion to a large jar with a tight-fitting lid. Shake until sugar is dissolved. Refrigerate and shake well before using.
